translation.name: Nasoruan siGot len nasoruan ta Uluveu

content: Ahai susur gail, aYesu ekǝkas narielito

NǝPasova tipat pelan, ale aYesu elǝboii ke namityal togǝm hǝn b̃eriŋ navile a pan, hǝn b̃ivan hǝn aTata. Elǝmas bun alat lotohusuri len navile a pan, ale gagai eṽusan p̃arp̃ar hǝn na-lǝmas-buni-an san kavkav tǝban galito.
Nǝboŋ lotohanhan ut mǝdau, natǝmat esǝhar aJutas anatun aSimon Iskariot tia, hǝn aJutas b̃eriŋ aYesu len navǝlan aenemi san gail.
AYesu elǝboii ke aTata toriŋ natit p̃isi len navǝlan, ale elǝboii am ke togǝm len aGot, mai dereh tetǝlmam van hǝni.
Ŋa ile mǝhat dan nǝhanan, ikol nahurabat san dani, ale ilav nǝtaol, epitavisi.
Beti eb̃ir nǝwai len nabesin, etub̃at kǝkas narien ahai susur gail, ale igar gail hǝn nǝtaol topitavisi.
Nǝboŋ tobar aSimon Pita, aPita ike, “Nasub̃, gekǝkas nariegw a? Imabe?”
AYesu isor vari ke, “Gagai gǝsalǝboi sǝhot nǝsa notogole, be boŋ ideh dereh gelǝboii.”
APita ikel maii ke, “Asike gokǝkas nariegw boŋ ideh.” AYesu isor vari ke, “Asike nǝb̃ekǝkas nariem̃, darepǝpehw. Gǝsavi ahai susur sagw am.”
ASimon Pita isor tǝvah ke, “B̃imaienan, Nasub̃, sagekǝkas nariegw ŋai be gekǝkas navǝlagw mai nǝkadugw am.”
AYesu ikel maii ke, “Avan tolilos tia iveveu, inor hǝn b̃ekǝkas narien ŋai hǝn b̃iveveu kavkav. Gamit mǝtuveveu, avil savi gamit p̃isi.”
AYesu ekǝmaienan husur elǝboi ase b̃eriŋi len navǝlan aenemi san gail. Husur enan ike, “Savi gamit p̃isi mǝttoveveu.”
Nǝboŋ tokǝkas narielit tonoŋ, esun tǝlmam hǝn nahurabat san, ale ipat tarhǝgarin tǝtas. Ikel mai galit ke, “Mǝtolǝboi nǝsa notomadhagole m̃os gamito?
Mǝtokis ginau hǝn ‘Hai p̃usan’ mai ‘Nasub̃’ ale inor hǝn mǝtb̃igole husur ginau boh numaienan.
Imagenan, ginau notovi ahai p̃usan mai Nasub̃ notoil a m̃o hǝn gamito, bathut notokǝkas nariemito sum̃an naslev, gamit gabag mitimassum̃an naslev hǝn mǝtb̃evi tarhǝt samito, kǝkas nariemito.
Ginau noṽusan naṽide tonor hǝn mǝtb̃igol tǝtoṽ hǝni. Natgalen notogole hǝn gamito, mitimasgol husuri.
Kitin nokitin mai gamit ke, naslev satibau sǝhor amasta san, mai ahai pispisul satibau sǝhor gai tosǝvati.
Mǝtolǝboi natgalen tia, ale mitigole! Mǝtb̃igol natgalenan, aGot tivoi hǝn gamito.
“Nǝsasor husur gamit p̃isi. Nolǝboi bun gamit ṽisusua notolekis hǝn gamito. Avil natosian siGot timassarpoh. Ike, ‘Nǝvanuan namrtohan katǝp̃ol hǝn nabǝta, ipair dan ginau, evi enemi sagw.’
Gagai nukel nategai mai gamit hǝn ke nǝboŋ b̃evisi, dereh mǝtedǝlomi ke ginau bogai notovi ginau hum notokele tia.
Kitin notokitin mai gamit ke, avan ideh tohǝhaṽur hǝn nǝvanuan notosǝvati, ehǝhaṽur hǝn ginau, ale avan ideh tohǝhaṽur hǝn ginau ehǝhaṽur hǝn gai tosǝvat ginau.”
AYesu ikel ur nǝsa b̃evisi hǝni balai
Nǝboŋ aYesu tokǝmaienan tonoŋ, elǝŋon isa vǝsa hǝni, nǝlon etuhatuh masuṽ ale isor tǝvah, ike, “Kitin, notokitin mai gamit ke gamit sua dereh teriŋ ginau len navǝlan aenemi sagw gail.”
Ahai susur gail lǝsǝnau lǝboi ase tosor husuri, gol ke lobunbunus galit gabag ŋai.
Galit sua, aYesu tolǝmas buni, ipat tarhǝgarin tǝban aYesu.
Imaienan, aSimon Pita eŋit nǝhon van hǝn aten topat tǝban aYesu hǝn b̃eus aYesu ke, tosor husur ase.
Beti atenan esiŋasiŋ len nǝmabun aYesu, eusi ke, “Nasub̃, ase ganan?”
AYesu isor vari ke, “Ateg boh nǝb̃etutur hǝn natuhbǝta len nasiloh hǝn nasup̃ hǝn nǝb̃ilavi maii, gai bogai.” Ale nǝboŋ aYesu totutur hǝn nabǝta, ilavi mai aJutas anatun aSimon Iskariot.
Nǝboŋ aJutas tolav natuhbǝta enan tonoŋ, vǝha-sua ŋai aSetan eb̃is lan. Imaienan aYesu ikel maii ke, “Saṽsaṽut hǝn gǝb̃igol nǝsa gǝb̃igole.”
Galit lotopat hǝn nǝtarhǝgarilito tǝban natev lǝsalǝboi nǝsa aYesu tosor maii aJutas m̃osi.
Bathut aJutas tokǝtkǝta tǝban nǝvat salito, galit galevis lunau ke aYesu tokel maii ke teṽur natit gail m̃os nǝPasova pelan o tilav natideh mai namǝsal gail.
Ale nǝboŋ aJutas tohan natuhbǝta tonoŋ, vǝha-sua ŋai ivan. Evi nalenmariug.
Na-kel-buni-an veveu
Nǝboŋ aJutas tovan, aYesu ike, “Gagai aNatun Nǝvanuan etub̃at b̃is len nǝyalyalan san, ale dereh aGot tikad nǝyalyalan len nǝsa b̃evisi hǝn ginau, aNatun Nǝvanuan.
AGot b̃ikad nǝyalyalan len aNatun Nǝvanuan, dereh len gai gabag, aGot tilav nǝyalyalan mai aNatun Nǝvanuan, ale tilav tutut hǝni maii.
Anatugw gail, dereh nitoh kǝkereh mai gamit sal a tahw hǝn nǝb̃ivan. Beti, naut kǝmas mǝtb̃idoŋ ginau, be len naut nǝb̃evi lan, asike gogǝmai, hum notokele tia mai alat lotoil a m̃o hǝn naJu gail.
Nuke nikel nakelean veveu todaŋ mai gamit ke: Mǝtelǝmlǝmas bun gamit gabag! Sum̃an ŋai notolǝmas bun gamito, mǝtelǝmlǝmas bun gamit gabag.
Mǝtb̃elǝmlǝmas bun gamit gabag, len naṽide tomaienan, nǝvanuan p̃isi dereh lelǝboi sǝhoti ke, mǝttovi ahai susur sagw gail.”
Na-kel-gati-an sePita
ASimon Pita eusi ke, “Nasub̃, gevi be?” Ale aYesu isor vari ke, “Naut nǝb̃evi lan, gaiug godǝdas gǝb̃ehusur ginau vi lan. Be dereh gehusur ginau balai.”
Beti aPita eusi ke, “Nasub̃, husur nǝsa nǝsalǝboi nǝb̃ehusur gaiug gagai ŋai? Noutaut hǝn nǝb̃imat m̃os gaiug.”
AYesu isor vari ke, “Goutaut hǝn gǝb̃imat m̃os ginau a? Ao! Kitin, nokitin mai gaiug, pelan dudulan dereh gikel vǝha-tor hǝni ke gǝsalǝboi ginau, beti natoulum̃an tekǝkǝraiko.”

footnotes.text: 13.16 Hǝn naves 12-16, Luk 22.24-27. Namilen ke natideh aYesu tovi masta sidato tohǝhaṽur hǝn b̃igole, gidat dattovi nǝvanuan san gail, datimashǝhaṽur hǝn datb̃igol tǝtoṽ hǝni.

13.29 Nǝhanan hǝn nǝPasova ipat husur nǝmariboŋ tomǝlevtor ale hum ma aJutas tovan hǝn b̃eṽur nǝhanian ideh am. Len nalenmariug hǝn nǝPasova, naJu gail lukad naṽide sua hǝn lǝb̃ilav nǝvat mai namǝsal gail.
